_comment: Research output for plan.md section 3 item 6. Researched 2026-08-17.
Findings and verdict: supply/README.md.
`candidates` entries use EXACTLY the nine fields of manifestCandidateSchema
(tools/agent-supply-verifier/src/schema.ts), which is .strict() — any extra
field is rejected outright. So all research evidence lives in the separate
`research` map below, keyed by tokenId, and the `candidates` array can be
merged into tools/agent-supply-verifier/config/candidates.json as-is.
DO NOT merge before reading the two gates below.
GATE 1 — the three added candidates are almost certainly TEAM-OPERATED and are
flagged teamOperatedReference: true on that basis. They share one IP
(172.104.171.139) with the documented team agent 265375. Their owner wallets
differ from the team wallet and appear nowhere in the repo, so operator
identity could not be proven from outside the host. The user must confirm.
If they are NOT the team's, they are still not independent supply — they are a
third party sharing the team's server.
GATE 2 — positioncrew (266229/266231/266232/266234) is the single most
promising external provider found and is deliberately NOT in `candidates`.
Its registered endpoint is an unsubstituted `{agentId}` template that 404s,
and its agent cards declare zero skills. Adding it now would only produce
verification failures. It belongs in `research` until the operator fixes both.

indexerFacts.brokenChainFilter: chain_id=56 (snake_case) - ACCEPTED AND SILENTLY IGNORED, returns chains 1/56/97/2741/8453/42161 with unfiltered total 746319
indexerFacts.affectsRepo: No. tools/agent-supply-verifier/src/sources/8004scan.ts uses only the detail endpoint /agents/{chainId}/{tokenId} where chain is a path segment. A future LIST call using the snake_case spelling would silently ingest wrong-chain agents.
indexerFacts.noQualityFilter: verified=true, is_verified=true, sort=rank, sortBy=rank, orderBy=total_feedbacks, hasEndpoint=true and endpointVerified=true were all tried; every one returned the unfiltered total. There is no server-side way to ask for quality.

indexerFacts.rateLimit: HTTP 429 at roughly more than one request per second; space detail lookups out
